name: Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the production and distribution of an extensive range of cheese and liquid milk products. The company serves a diverse clientele, including both individual consumers and industrial customers, across China. Its comprehensive product line features various cheese varieties such as ready-to-eat nutritional cheese sticks, adult shredded cheese sticks, children's growing cups, mozzarella, cheese slices, cream cheese, butter, and grilled cheese, in addition to milk and other related dairy items. These products are made available through multiple sales channels, including independent distributors, the company's proprietary e-commerce platforms, prominent shopping centers, and major supermarkets. Established in 1998, Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd maintains its primary operational base in Shanghai, China.
